def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Find the single-color full-length divider, horizontal or vertical.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if all(v==2 for v in g[r])]
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==2 for r in range(h))]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c] not in (2,6,8)]
    if not cells:return g
    if rows:
        top=min(r for r,c in cells)
        if top>0:g[top-1]=[8]*w
    elif cols:
        barrier=cols[0]
        right=max(c for r,c in cells)
        # parallel stripe is offset from the object by its gap to divider
        stripe=2*right-barrier
        if 0<=stripe<w:
            for r in range(h):
                if g[r][stripe]!=2:g[r][stripe]=8
    return g
